# Conformance `expected.error` cases the SELF-HOST checker does not reject.
#
# Read by TestSelfHostRejectsConformanceErrorCasesX86_64, exactly in both
# directions: a case listed here must still be accepted, and a case not listed
# must be rejected. So closing a gap fails this gate until its line is deleted,
# and a working rejection can never silently regress into one.
#
# Every bare line below is a program native REFUSES and the self-host compiles.
# One is closed: diag_e010 (a user struct shadowing a reserved built-in name)
# now draws the same E010 native gives, so its line is gone from here.
# That is a gap, not a licence: `err_map_key_no_hash` reaches wasm as a module
# that does not validate, calling a `$Has.hash` nothing defines.
#
# `parse:` lines are a scoping boundary, not a gap: the source does not parse,
# so it never reaches a checker and this gate has nothing to read. They are
# pinned rather than skipped so that a case which starts parsing is reported.

diag_e019
diag_e033
diag_e073
diag_e074
err_duplicate_field
err_map_key_no_hash
sat_const_rejected
sat_usize_rejected
tuple_match_err_nonexhaustive
underscore_not_readable

parse:diag_p001
parse:diag_p002
parse:diag_p003
parse:diag_p004
parse:diag_p005
